Microwave-assisted extraction (MAE) utilizing a hydrophilic ionic liquid, 1-Butyl-3-methylimidazolium tetrafluoroborate (BMIM)(BF4), was employed to extract chlorogenic acid from green coffee beans, employing Box-Behnken response surface methodology (BRSM). The yield of...
